summary: Operator home, campsites/rates, seasonal, ATV, FAQ, rules pages, the site map PDF, Google, gateways and imagery read. 2027 RV rates $60-95 (summer $70-95). Drop candidate on price; ATV trail system on property flagged; ~40% of sites overnight by the map; pond value questioned (lined swim pond behind a day-use beach).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (price gate): the ordinary summer RV site is over $50. 2027 PEAK (May 28-Sept 6) 'Back-in W&E Starts at $70/$80/$90' and 'All Other Camp Site Types Starts at $75/$80/$95' (weekday/weekend/holiday); even off-peak RV is $60-75. Not a Good Sam Park (stored good_sam false), no member discount posted, no gateway within 40 km. Google 4.3 (94); RV Life 4* $$.

OHV FLAG (reviewer decides): the park runs its own UTV trail system starting on the property - 'there are several trails accessible right on-property for you to explore with your off-road vehicle!', '$50/day per rig fee to use the trails', 'dedicated parking for your off-road rigs', UTV rentals on the site map; the home page carries 'campground is connected to 100s of miles of ATV trails'. It is otherwise a general family campground (swim pond, mini golf, events).

LONG-STAY: site map (Oct 2024) colour-codes about 58 overnight sites (purple/pink) against about 89 seasonal sites (white) - roughly 40% nightly; 'NEW Wooded Seasonal Sites for 2025' and 'SEASONAL SITES AVAILABLE Immediate Occupancy'. Seasonal from $2,500. Nightly rates and online booking posted, so tests 2/4 pass; no lot sales. If kept, the note should say: 'Mostly seasonal: about 58 of its roughly 147 sites are sold by the night.' Minimum age 21 to reserve.

WATERFRONT 'pond' -> not waterfront proposed: the water is a lined swimming pond ('NO digging deep in the sand - there is a liner') of about 55 x 25 m inside a sand beach that is a paid public day-use area ('PUBLIC DAY VISITOR - SWIM POND WRISTBAND'). The nearest overnight sites (508-511) sit across the cabin road and the beach from it, about 35-45 m away, not on its edge. An amenity pool, with day-use between.
SITE COUNT: stored 75 (note prose) is unsourced; the site map numbers about 147 sites plus cabins. Not written. Stored 50-amp electric not stated on any page read; left.
PIN 45.7545,-91.8832 at the Red Barn hall in the middle of the loops: fine. WEBSITE https://redbarncampground.com/ and PHONE 715-731-0032 confirmed.
